title: Live in Tents All Your Days

request.style: English, Male solo voice, warm and reverent, acoustic guitar, cello, gentle percussion, soft piano, choir backing, solemn and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Go to the house of the Rechabites now
Bring them into the chamber here
Set before them bowls full of wine
And say to them, drink some

[Pre-Chorus]
We drink no wine, our father said
You and your children never will
No houses built, no seed sown down
No vineyards planted or owned

[Chorus]
Live in tents all your days
So that you may live long
Obeying the voice of the father
Keeping the command strong

[Verse]
We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab
In everything he commanded us
To drink no wine all our days
Neither wives nor sons nor daughters

[Chorus]
Live in tents all your days
So that you may live long
Obeying the voice of the father
Keeping the command strong

[Bridge]
But I have spoken to you again
And you have not listened to me
You would not incline your ear
To the words I sent down

[Outro]
Jonadab son of Rechab
Will never lack a descendant
To stand before me forever
Faithful to the end
